metadata.title_zh: 首个人造细胞实现生长与分裂
metadata.detailed_summary_zh: 科学家首次制造出一种完全从零构建的合成细胞“SpudCell”，它能够自主生长、分裂并完成完整的生命周期。 这是合成生物学领域的里程碑式突破，为理解生命起源和设计人造生物系统提供了全新平台，未来可能在生物制造、医学等领域带来革命性应用。 SpudCell 没有使用天然的细胞骨架，而是通过一种新型膜结构实现分裂；其基因组包含合成DNA，并能响应基因调控来加速生长与分裂。
metadata.background_zh: 传统合成细胞研究一直无法实现细胞分裂，因为自然细胞依赖复杂的细胞骨架进行分裂。SpudCell 通过设计全新的分裂机制绕过了这一瓶颈，标志着从“合成基因组”向“合成生命”的关键跨越。
metadata.community_discussion_zh: 社区讨论热烈，部分学者质疑该研究的创新性，指出SpudCell 尚未满足所有生命定义标准；也有人批评研究团队绕过同行评审直接向媒体宣传的做法，但多数评论认可其实验技术上的突破。

metadata.title_zh: 欧盟-美国数据隐私框架面临法律挑战
metadata.detailed_summary_zh: 欧洲法院在2020年Schrems II案中裁定欧盟-美国隐私盾协议无效，导致跨大西洋数据转移机制受创。 这一裁决迫使依赖该框架的公司寻找替代方案，可能中断数千家企业的数据流动，影响全球科技行业运营。 隐私盾协议于2016年生效，旨在替代被废除的安全港协议；其被废除源于对美国监视法律的担忧。
metadata.background_zh: 欧盟通用数据保护条例（GDPR）严格限制个人数据向保护不足的国家传输。隐私盾曾作为美国公司合规的依据，但欧洲法院认为美国国家安全法律未能提供与欧盟同等的保护。

metadata.title_zh: 索尼宣布2028年1月停止新游戏光盘生产
metadata.detailed_summary_zh: 索尼宣布将于2028年1月起停止生产适用于PlayStation主机的新游戏实体光盘，这意味着未来新发行的PS游戏将仅提供数字版本。 此举标志着游戏行业全面转向数字发行的重大里程碑，可能对游戏收藏、二手交易以及长期游戏保存产生深远影响，引发玩家对数字所有权和DRM的担忧。 该决定仅适用于新发行的游戏，已发行的实体游戏仍可继续销售和游玩，但未来可能逐步退出市场。索尼未提及现有光盘游戏是否仍可继续获得更新或补丁。
metadata.background_zh: 近年来游戏行业数字下载比例逐年上升，但实体光盘仍受到部分玩家青睐，因其提供所有权感、无需联网即可游玩，且可在二手市场交易。索尼此前已有删除用户已购买数字内容记录（如电影）的先例，加剧了玩家对数字版权的信任危机。
metadata.community_discussion_zh: 社区评论普遍持反对态度。有用户指出索尼本周刚删除了数百部用户已购买的电影且未退款，提醒大家数字内容实为租赁而非拥有。另有用户认为这是游戏界的“黑暗时代”，DRM、在线验证和数字内容可能随公司倒闭消失。还有用户举例说明《黑暗之魂3》实体版仅需11美元而数字版仍需60美元，凸显实体和数字的性价比差距。

title: FFmpeg 9.1's new AAC encoder
content:
--- Top Comments ---

[cogman10]: Man what a showcase for Opus this is. Don't get me wrong, this sort of thing is a valuable exercise and we are better off with better encoders for these older codecs.  But look at the numbers for Opus on this benchmark.  It simply blows all the AAC encoders out of the water even at 64 kbps.

[ndiddy]: Nice, I'm looking forward to seeing how this performs in practice. FFmpeg's previous AAC encoder produced poor quality output and often had irritating chirping artifacts, so I've always had to install Apple's Core Audio encoder on any computer I do video recording on to get decent sound. I've done A/B/X comparisons and found that a 320kbps MP3 sounds better than a 320kbps AAC encoded by FFmpeg, but about the same as a 256kbps AAC encoded by Core Audio. If in...

[HugoTea]: >FFmpeg's AAC DEcoder is busted with regards to stereo PNS, and the bug may be in other AAC decoders too, so we work around it in the encoder. Since no other encoder used PNS, the bug was not found until now. I don't know what PNS is, but I bet this has been bothering someone's niche use-case for 20 years

[JSR_FDED]: It’s fascinating so much of this comes down to the developer’s own ears - disturbing and quite cool at the same time how subjective this is

[superzazu]: > The encoder was mainly optimized for 48Khz audio. Get over it. It's 2026, resampling is free, 48Khz is the standard. 44.1Khz will work, and so will 96Khz but use 48Khz if you want the best quality. Is 48kHz really the standard nowadays?

metadata.title_zh: FFmpeg 9.1 发布全新 AAC 编码器
metadata.detailed_summary_zh: FFmpeg 9.1 版本引入了一个全新的 AAC 音频编码器，显著提升了编码质量，并修复了之前版本中存在的刺耳伪影问题。 这对依赖 FFmpeg 进行音频处理的开发者和用户非常重要，因为之前的内置 AAC 编码器质量较差，用户常需安装第三方编码器。新编码器有望减少外部依赖，提升 FFmpeg 在音频转码领域的竞争力。 新编码器主要针对 48kHz 音频优化，但也支持 44.1kHz 和 96kHz。此外，编码器绕过了某些 AAC 解码器在处理立体声 PNS（感知噪声替代）时的 bug。
metadata.background_zh: AAC（高级音频编码）是一种广泛使用的有损音频压缩格式。FFmpeg 是一个流行的开源多媒体框架，但其内置的 AAC 编码器长期被批评质量不佳，存在 chirping 等伪影。许多用户转而使用其他编码器如 libfdk_aac 或 Apple Core Audio。此次更新旨在解决这些问题。
metadata.community_discussion_zh: 社区对此次更新反应积极，但也有一些讨论。部分用户注意到 Opus 编码器在相同比特率下表现更优，认为 Opus 仍是最佳选择。有开发者提到新编码器绕过了 AAC 解码器中的 PNS bug，但普通用户对此可能不熟悉。还有人质疑 48kHz 是否已成为行业标准。

title: Box3D, an open source 3D physics engine
content:
--- Top Comments --- [gregsadetsky]: Whenever I see Box2D mentioned (the library by the same author as Box3D, obviously), I think back to this story from many years ago https://kotaku.com/this-guy-created-angry-birds-physics-and-... [RobLach]: Box2D was a foundation for a lot of interesting physics oriented indie games in my day. I wonder if the landscape is empty enough for a resurgence. [Jeaye]: Yes! This is exciting to see. Erin Catto is such a cool hacker. Thank you, Erin, for sharing your code with the open source community. There wasn't anything about determinism in the announcement, but I'd really love to see some more about that, too. Trying to use Unity's built-in physics to make a networked billiards game is quite troubling, when none of the clients can happily agree on what happened. [adalacelove]: Physics simulation is a dangerous rabbit hole. Even if you focus just on rigid bodies and just physical plausibility there are plenty of open problems related to collision detection and collision resolution. Convex approximations and/or decompositions for geometry and hand tuning of solvers are the norm, balancing robustness and precision against speed. [ainch]: As an ML researcher, I know box2d because it underpins many of the standard reinforcement learning environments (in OpenAI Gym) that we use to benchmark methods, like Lunar Lander or Car Racing: https://gymnasium.farama.org/environments/box2d/car_racing/ Thanks to Erin for such a useful piece of software! --- From rss ---

Comments
author: makepanic

metadata.detailed_summary_zh: Erin Catto（Box2D作者）宣布发布Box3D，这是一个完全用C语言编写的开源3D物理引擎，旨在为游戏和仿真提供刚体物理模拟。 Box3D的发布填补了开源3D物理引擎领域的空白，其前身Box2D曾广泛用于游戏开发和强化学习环境（如OpenAI Gym），因此Box3D有望成为新一代物理仿真基础工具。 Box3D采用鲁棒的软步刚体求解器，并包含传感器系统，提供原生C API，支持静态链接或作为子项目使用（仅编译库，跳过示例和测试）。
metadata.background_zh: Box2D是Erin Catto开发的开源2D物理引擎，被众多游戏（如《愤怒的小鸟》）和机器学习基准环境采用。3D物理引擎领域长期由商业引擎主导，开源选项稀少。Box3D旨在继承Box2D的简洁高效，扩展到三维空间。
metadata.community_discussion_zh: 社区反响热烈，多位开发者回忆Box2D对独立游戏和机器学习环境的贡献；也有用户关注物理引擎的确定性问题（如网络对战中的一致性）以及碰撞检测与求解器调优的挑战。

title: Monetization Gateway: Charge for any resource behind Cloudflare via x402
content:
--- Top Comments ---

[arjie]: This is the dream of microtransactions and agents-paying-for-access that so many people have always wanted. It was never going to be implemented on existing payment rails so it would have to be something like this. I can't wait to see it in play somewhere because I am increasingly annoyed that I have to own API keys on various platforms etc. etc. I just want my agent to make decisions and spend a limited amount of money (this is on me to cover) just like a human agent can. If we get the ...

[cphoover]: This doesn't seem to solve the issue that website operators face... which is providing a free public experience to humans while the price of hosting is driven up by increased bot traffic. The issue isn't charging for API access with request caps, that's not hard to do. It's preserving the free experience for our users while our traffic is increasingly made up of bots. The problem is that AI has made it increasingly difficult to tell bot from human. Baking microtransactions...

[mixedbit]: With payments the complexity is not only in accepting a payment, but largely in doing so legally. Someone makes a request to my company's paid service, I return 402 and get a stable coin back. Who do I invoice for this revenue? What value added tax do I apply to the invoice? If someone makes 10k paid requests within one month, do I have means of generating one invoice for them for all the usage, or is every request treated separately and results in 10k invoices?
Will CloudFlare handle th...

[thatmf]: All for this. Micropayments have been tried so many times before, but they all relied on user opt-in and never reached any sort of critical mass. Someone of Cloudflare's scale could actually pull it off.

[_pdp_]: I might be in the minority here, but although x402 sounds useful, it seems to me that adoption will be an uphill struggle, especially for per-request micropayments. The most likely scenario is Stripe, or someone similar, creating an agentic API connected to the agent owner linked account or something along those lines. title: How We Made IPFS Content Publishing 10x Faster
content:
--- Top Comments ---

[embedding-shape]: > Return control back to the user after most (not all) of the PUT RPCs have succeeded and continue with the remaining ones in the background. Making things faster by doing less (and not the same) been speeding up computing since forever! Can't help but feel like it's slightly misleading to call the providing ("publishing") faster when it's not actually doing the same, it's just that most parts turned async instead of waiting for confirmation. Wouldn't thi...

[boramalper]: Is anyone still (or has anyone ever) used IPFS in production? I’m not talking about technology demos such as Wikipedia-on-IPFS (which indeed worked and was impressive) but where IPFS is actually being relied on for some functionality.

[hannesfur]: Having worked on libp2p‘s DHT (Double Hashing for rust-libp2p) for a bit two years ago, it’s really great to see that there are improvements. 
To get to CDN level speeds though on dense networks, I still see it as an architectural flaw to not somehow encode network topology into the PeerID / identity in the DHT. A start would be to use the five RIRs. If you want to be more sophisticated, and I spent a lot of time theorising about this, you could have a dezentrally governed anycast IP add...

[someonebaggy]: Is it also possible to speed up lookup? I never used IPFS much as it took several minutes to find a cid.

[davidwritesbugs]: Slightly tangential to the article, which seems interesting, but the main issue with IPFS was the horrendous performance of clients which I seem to recall related to having a refresh storms, sparse routing tables, unreachable peers as well as lookup speeds. Mostly the reputation was so bad that people didn't bother with it, I dismissed it for my own project. If your only users are crypto-grift projects you're in a bad place.
author: dennis-tra

metadata.title_zh: IPFS通过乐观提供算法实现10倍发布加速
metadata.detailed_summary_zh: IPFS开发团队提出了一种名为“乐观提供”（Optimistic Provide）的新算法，该算法在大部分PUT RPC成功后就立即返回控制权，并将剩余任务异步后台完成，从而将内容发布速度提升10倍。 这一改进显著降低了IPFS内容发布延迟，提升了用户体验，并可能推动IPFS在更多实际生产场景中的应用，尤其是在需要快速上链的去中心化存储应用中。 该方法并未减少工作量，而是将同步等待改为异步处理，因此实际发布流程并未完全完成，但用户可更快获得反馈。结合“重新提供扫描”（Reprovide Sweep）机制，可确保内容最终被DHT收录。
metadata.background_zh: IPFS是一个点对点分布式文件系统，使用分布式哈希表（DHT）进行内容路由和提供。当用户发布内容时，需要将内容标识符（CID）广播到DHT中，这个过程称为“提供”（provide）。传统提供需要等待所有DHT节点确认，导致延迟较高。
metadata.community_discussion_zh: 评论中有人质疑称，这种优化本质上是将同步等待转为异步，并非真正的加速，只是“做更少的事”。也有用户反映IPFS查找速度慢是更大痛点。此外，部分评论者对IPFS在生产中的可靠性持保留态度，认为其声誉因性能问题受损。

title: All Package Management Functionality Moved from Compiler to Build System
author: ziglang.org via FedericoSchonborn

metadata.title_zh: Zig将包管理功能从编译器移至构建系统
metadata.detailed_summary_zh: Zig语言在官方开发日志中宣布，所有包管理功能将从编译器迁移至构建系统，这一架构调整自2026年6月30日起生效。 这是Zig语言的重大架构变更，将简化编译器的职责，增强构建系统的统一性和可维护性，影响所有Zig开发者的工作流程。 此前包管理部分功能由编译器处理，迁移后完全由构建系统（如build.zig和build.zig.zon）负责，编译器将更专注于代码编译本身。

title: How Kent Beck shapes the software engineering industry

metadata.title_zh: 肯特·贝克谈AI时代软件工程信任优先
metadata.detailed_summary_zh: 软件工程先驱肯特·贝克近期发表观点，强调在AI时代，建立信任比生成代码更为重要，并回顾了敏捷开发和测试驱动开发（TDD）的核心理念。 这一观点挑战了当前业界对AI自动生成代码的过度追捧，提醒开发者关注软件工程中人的因素和协作质量，可能会影响未来开发工具和团队文化的演进方向。 肯特·贝克是敏捷开发和TDD的创始人之一，他在访谈中提出，AI虽然能提升代码生产效率，但长期项目成功取决于开发者之间以及开发者与用户之间的信任关系。

metadata.title_zh: Z.ai 发布 ZCode：GLM-5.2 官方桌面编码代理
metadata.detailed_summary_zh: Z.ai 推出了 ZCode，一款专为 GLM-5.2 模型设计的桌面编码代理应用，旨在集成 AI 代理与现有开发工具链。 这标志着 Z.ai 在 AI 辅助编程领域的进一步布局，ZCode 提供了桌面级交互体验，可能改变开发者使用 AI 编码的方式，但定价透明度和与开源工具的对比引发了社区广泛讨论。 ZCode 并非模型本身，而是一个编码代理环境；它支持与众多 CLI 编码代理集成，并提供了类似 Codex App 或 Claude App 的桌面 UI。目前 ZCode 未开源，其“基础用量”定价细节不透明。
metadata.background_zh: GLM-5.2 是 Z.ai 开发的开源大语言模型（MIT 许可），擅长将论文转化为可运行代码。ZCode 则是该模型的官方桌面适配工具，旨在简化编码流程。社区中已有如 MiMo-Code、OpenCode 等开源或替代工具存在。
metadata.community_discussion_zh: 社区对 ZCode 的定价不透明表示质疑，认为“基础用量”等概念模糊不清；同时，部分用户更倾向于使用现有的 CLI 或 TUI 编码代理，认为桌面版并非必需；也有用户注意到 ZCode 外观精致，但与开源替代品（如 OpenCode）相比吸引力有限。

title: Show HN: Searchable directory of 22k+ products from worker-owned co-ops
content:
--- Top Comments ---

[robot_jesus]: Neat project and I love the motivations behind it. A few friendly recommendations: • The images on the results pages are in desperate need of optimization. Plenty of 500KB+ thumbnails and even a couple 2MB+ thumbnails I saw in there. Could easily be optimized 90%+ with no loss of quality • The instant live search can be a little distracting, particularly paired with the heavy loading of the thumbnails • I know you don't want to create your own full ecomm site, but even just a hover PDP w...

[daheza]: Very nice and appreciate the effort you put into making this. Some Improvements that could help: 
the location search could be an actual map with pins which would be easier to use
some kind of tags for the different appareal items would help clarify which one, currently i have to click and search each vendor for things im looking for. Specifically autistic friendly / sensory clothing items.

[LPisGood]: I wonder of there is a version of this but for jobs?

[thousandflowers]: Really nice project! It will be intresing an automation that check online for word like “worker cooperative”, “worker-owned” to find new candidate that fit. Ofc the hard part is confirming if it's genuinely worker-owned, so keeping that step human makes sense. But the discovery/shortlisting could be largely automated crawl the web, score candidates by how many co-op signals they hit, and present the top ones for you to vet. Would be happy to help prototype something like this if you...

[benonsocial]: Terrific idea. I agree with daheza. Location search would be an awesome feature. The site is blazing fast. Great work. Keep it up.

metadata.title_zh: 工人合作社产品目录上线，收录超2.2万种商品
metadata.detailed_summary_zh: 推出一个可搜索的在线目录，收集了来自全球工人合作社的22,000多种产品，旨在帮助消费者支持道德消费。 为消费者提供了便捷途径去发现和购买工人合作社的产品，推动工人所有制经济模式的发展，对关注社会企业和道德消费的群体具有重要价值。 该目录不直接销售商品，而是链接到各合作社的网站；社区反馈指出需要优化图片大小、改进即时搜索体验，并建议增加地图搜索和商品标签等功能。
metadata.background_zh: 工人合作社是由工人共同拥有并民主管理的企业，以工人和社区利益为核心目标。研究表明，这类企业能提供更好的工作条件和工资，有助于推动经济正义和社会变革。
metadata.community_discussion_zh: 社区普遍赞赏该项目的动机和实用性，同时提出了建设性改进意见，例如优化大尺寸图片以减少加载时间、改进即时搜索的干扰性，以及增加地图定位和服装品类标签。此外，部分用户希望未来能有类似的工作机会目录或自动发现工具。

title: Internal Combustion Engine (2021)
content:
--- Top Comments ---

[londons_explore]: Worth noting the design of the internal combustion engine hasn't changed much in 50 years. The thing that has changed is the control systems. What used to be a primitive mechanical way of mixing fuel and air (the carburettor), is now an electronic fuel injection system, with the fuel air ratio very carefully matched to reduce pollution (fun fact:  modern cars release so little carbon monoxide, you won't kill yourself by starting one in a garage (but don't try it just incase you...

[bob1029]: > Presence of oil is critical here as it creates conditions for hydrodynamic lubrication. You can hear this effect in some vehicles at initial startup time for a few seconds. I know of certain Ford engines where it actually causes issues over time. The model years with auto start/stop have the worst of the cam rattle disease.

[rootusrootus]: I still remember the first time I tore down a pushrod V8.  I decided it had to be close to the pinnacle of elegant design.  Nothing wasted, everything had a purpose, and it all came together in a perfect mechanical symphony.  We have since made engines which are significantly more efficient and powerful, but all of that at the cost of elegance, slapping on overhead cams and machinery just to adjust the valve timing, etc.  Fantastic technology in it's own right for certain, but feels tack...

[fauria]: " in real running engines the rotating crankshaft should float completely on a very thin surface of oil " - I found this to be a great insight.

[CraigJPerry]: The thing that's missing here that really drastically changes the story is all the emissions control hardware that would exist on such an engine. This is a circa 1990s engine in the US market i think? Dual Overhead Cam didn't really become popular in the US market until then i think. 70s-80s for single overhead cam to become established. The diagrams are beautiful and informative as always from this author.

metadata.detailed_summary_zh: 这篇文章是2021年发布的互动式技术深潜，通过精美图示和动画详细解释了内燃机从曲轴到气门的完整工作原理。 尽管内燃机的基本设计数十年来变化不大，但控制系统的进步极大地提高了效率和环保性，这篇文章帮助读者理解这一经典技术的内在机理。 文章重点介绍了流体动力润滑等关键概念，指出曲轴应在极薄油膜上浮动；社区讨论还补充了现代发动机通过电子燃油喷射和排放控制大幅降低污染物的细节。
metadata.background_zh: 内燃机是一种将燃料燃烧产生的热能转化为机械能的热机，通常用于汽车驱动。基本结构包括气缸、活塞、连杆、曲轴和气门机构。现代内燃机采用电子燃油喷射和三元催化器等排放控制技术，而早期则使用化油器和机械控制方式。

title: Low-level Haskell: The cursed way to emulate inline assembly in Haskell/GHC
author: minoki.github.io via abhin4v

metadata.title_zh: 用GHC原语在Haskell中模拟内联汇编的“诅咒”方式
metadata.detailed_summary_zh: 一位开发者发表了一篇技术文章，展示了一种使用GHC的foreign import prim机制来模拟内联汇编的非传统方法，从而在Haskell中直接嵌入底层指令。 这项技巧为Haskell开发者提供了一种绕过高级抽象、直接操作底层硬件的方法，在性能关键或需要特定CPU指令的场景下具有潜在价值，但因其脆弱性和对GHC内部接口的依赖而被称为“诅咒”方式。 该方法依赖GHC的prim类型和操作，通过foreign import prim导入C级函数或汇编代码，并返回多个值，类似于内联汇编的效果。但ghc-prim包仅供GHC开发者使用，普通用户使用会面临无预警的破坏性变更风险。
metadata.background_zh: Haskell通常不提供内联汇编功能，因为其高级抽象和跨平台兼容性设计。GHC primitives是GHC内部提供的底层类型和操作，通常不对外开放。foreign import prim是一种FFI扩展，允许导入用C或汇编编写的原始函数。本文探索了利用这些特性在Haskell中嵌入汇编代码的可能性。
